rules.text: Items purchased in-store can be exchanged for another item with the original receipt.
rules.quote: With the original receipt, items can be exchanged for another item, or a refund will be issued in the original form of payment.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that a refund is also an option with the original receipt, not just an exchange. The quote mentions both exchange and refund.

rules.text: Refunds for in-store purchases with original receipt will be issued in the original form of payment.
rules.quote: With the original receipt, items can be exchanged for another item, or a refund will be issued in the original form of payment.

rules.text: Items purchased in-store without the original receipt can be exchanged at the current scanned price.
rules.quote: Without the original receipt, items can be exchanged at the current scanned price.

rules.text: Refunds and exchanges are not provided for gift cards or prepaid financial cards.
rules.quote: Refunds and exchanges are not provided for gift cards or prepaid financial cards.

rules.text: All sales are final for orders placed online at DollarTree.com.
rules.quote: For online purchases: All sales are final for orders placed at DollarTree.com.

rules.text: Online purchases cannot be returned or refunded unless the order is incomplete or items arrived damaged.
rules.quote: However, if your order is incomplete or your items arrived damaged, call 1-877-530-TREE (8733) with your order information and our Customer Order Support Team will assist with a resolution.
